g.text: A console-style studio for EasySMX controllers
Eight EasySMX models, each with its own layout and tools
Four player slots, each with its own controller
Pick a button, press what it should do
Live response curves with a real-time dot
Step-by-step timelines for M1 to M6
Grip and trigger motors, previewed live
A virtual Xbox pad with your settings applied
Drift, chatter and report rate, read-only
